terbaru.judul: From PID to Reinforcement Learning in Building HVAC Control: A Control-Architecture Review of Tuning Strategies, Formulations, and Deployment Trade-offs
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper reviews control architectures for building heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC) systems, addressing the tension among energy demand, occupant comfort and equipment operability, and situating proportional-integral-derivative (PID) regulation within a layered control stack that also includes rule-based and model-based

terbaru.judul: Reap: Uncovering Monte Carlo proof search with a lightweight model
terbaru.pelajaran: We present Reap, an open framework for learning and analyzing formal proof search in Lean4.

terbaru.judul: Learning Purposeful Co-designs of Bio-inspired Quadrupedal Robots
terbaru.pelajaran: Treating morphology and control as separate design problems has constrained the efficiency and adaptability of quadrupedal robots, while current co-design approaches are often constrained by restricted design spaces.

terbaru.judul: Dataset Mismatch Matters in Group Relative Policy Optimization for Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we propose learning-to-reweight rollout (L2RR) that explicitly incorporates target-side performance feedback into GRPO.

terbaru.judul: Behavioral Steering of Vision-Language-Action Models in the Low-Parameter Regime
terbaru.pelajaran: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly used to adapt pretrained vision-language-action models (VLAs).

terbaru.judul: Transformer-Based Reinforcement Learning for Phase I Dose Allocation
terbaru.pelajaran: Phase I dose-finding trials must learn from sparse toxicity observations while limiting exposure to overly toxic doses.

terbaru.judul: Sandman: A Sandbox Service for Production Agentic Reinforcement Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: We present Sandman, a sandbox service built and operated at Amazon for large-scale agentic RL workloads in production on shared Kubernetes.
